decision.explanation: The question asks which sports team Fenna Vanhoutte represents. Document 1 (D1S1-D1S14) explicitly states she is a member of 'Lotto Dstny Ladies' cycling team. Document 2 (D2S1-D2S21) explicitly states she transferred to 'Esteghlal F.C.', an Iranian association football club. Both documents provide direct assertions of her representation of these respective teams, supporting the retention of both answers as distinct valid referents for the same entity under the 'represents' relation.
